title: What my gym can see says the app never sends which exercises you did, even while gym-mate sharing sends them
what: The page's opening text says MettleUp never sends which exercises you did. The page only drops that line when the gym has busy machines on or when the trainer view has loaded. The gym-mate sharing switch sits on the same page, and when it is on the app sends up to 30 workouts with the best set of each exercise. So a member who turned on gym-mate sharing reads, on the very page where they switched it on, that their exercises are never sent. The same happens if the trainer view could not be read (for example with no signal) while trainer sharing is on.
expected: The opening text only says what is true for this member right now: when gym-mate or trainer sharing is on, it says which exercises and sets are sent and to whom.
who: gym members who share workouts with gym mates or trainers
how_often: every visit to the page while such sharing is on and busy machines is off
fix_line: Pick the opening text from every sharing switch that is on, not just busy machines and the trainer view.

items.reason: 3 promises. P-A7-phone-watch-1-18 kept: Discard empties the saved draft and every field of the open workout; nothing of a live workout is sent anywhere before it is saved. P-A7-phone-watch-1-17 kept: the readiness read uses only this phone's workout and set tables, no health, sleep or heart data (imported workouts count too, which is wording, not privacy). P-A7-phone-watch-1-22 kept: the finish screen opens only after the save returned a workout id. No finding.

Notice: What my gym can see tells a sharing member their exercises are never sent (finding 01). Consent: trainer sharing that starts at joining is already FN-L4-phone-shop-2-03. Purpose: Ask an AI only opens the share menu and leaves out name, phone and body weight; share pictures and texts keep body weight out. Deletion: see L4.6. Children: the age box is not in this area; the gap is already FN-L4-phone-cloud-backup-ai-02. Breach timing: no screen here holds it.

These phone screens give no one at MettleUp a way to see gym data; the only thing the team reads from here is a help message, which the notice lists. Staff access and its read log live on the server and in HQ.

Trainer sharing on What my gym can see sends up to 12 months while the notice says 3 months: already FN-L4-phone-shop-2-01. Gym-mate sharing caption (60 days, deleted when off) matches the notice. Ask an AI keeps nothing.

Help and feedback sends the gym member key, which the notice does not list: already FN-A5-phone-components-2-1-01. Progress photos page says the newest are in the phone's backup while the notice says photos never leave the phone: already FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01. The finish screen's richer note sends workout facts to Groq only with the hidden coach on and the member's own key; same gap as FN-L4-phone-components-1-01 (hidden coach sends undisclosed). Ask an AI sends nothing itself. No analytics or Health Connect send starts from these screens.

Delete my account (on Backup and restore) leaves workouts shared with the gym: already FN-L4-phone-cloud-backup-ai-01. Erase or start over reports success when photo files fail: already FN-L4-phone-components-2-03. Deleting a progress photo says removed for good, but a failed file delete is swallowed and copies in saved backups and Google's backup stay; same root as FN-L4-phone-tracker-components-2-01. Backups: the notice says copies expire within 7 days; the server side could not be checked from here.
